task_name: Milepost Driving Academy - Scenario clip training library
client_brief:
Milepost needs short training examples for the listed driving scenarios. Show the manoeuvre clearly enough that a nervous learner can follow the necessary stages, with narration and labels that agree with the approved instruction. The upright example must keep the relevant road context visible. Do not turn a disconnected set of road shots into apparent evidence of a completed manoeuvre. Adequate scenario footage and cleared narration are prerequisites, not something the editor should guess.

Deliverables
1. Driving-scenario training clip: 8 named exports. The narration matches the visual scenario. The instruction agrees with the cleared training copy.
2. Vertical training example: 1 named export. The relevant road context remains visible. The complete instruction is intelligible.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.
- Video delivery means a playable MP4, not a storyboard, still montage PDF or editing log. Audio expectations are stated on each film. Speech-led work requires supplied or explicitly authorised synthetic speech; do not invent documentary speech.
- Authored animation can exceed the duration of still source images. Live-action edits require adequate distinct footage; looping a short clip is not a substitute for the missing coverage.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

values.Steps: 1. Check your interior mirror for what is behind you. 2. Check the door mirror on the side you are moving to. 3. Signal in good time. 4. deliverables.name: Driving-scenario training clip - Left turns across traffic

values.Steps: 1. Begin slowing well before the junction. 2. Move to the correct position near the centre line. 3. Signal left across the oncoming lane in good time. 4. Stop at the give-way line if you cannot see a clear gap. 5. Watch the oncoming traffic and judge the gaps, not the cars. 6. Look through the turn to where you want to end up. 7. Check for pedestrians crossing the road you are entering. 8. Wait for a gap you are certain of, not one you are hoping for. 9. When the gap is clear, turn smoothly across the lane. 10. Keep your wheels straight while you wait so a knock will not push you forward. 11. Complete the turn into your own lane and cancel the signal.
values.Callout: When in doubt, wait. A missed gap costs seconds; a wrong one costs more.

deliverables.name: Driving-scenario training clip - Roundabouts

values.Steps: 1. Read the signs and road markings on the approach. 2. Slow down early and choose your lane before you arrive. 3. Give way to traffic already on the roundabout, usually from your left. 4. Wait for a gap and enter without stopping if you can. 5. Keep to your lane and follow the markings round. 6. Signal left as you pass the exit before the one you want. 7. Leave the roundabout in your lane and check your mirror.
values.Callout: Look left, take your time, and keep moving when it is clear.

deliverables.name: Driving-scenario training clip - Parallel parking

values.Steps: 1. Find a space at least a car and a half long. 2. Pull up level with the car in front, about half a metre out. 3. Check your mirrors and blind spot for anything coming. 4. Select reverse and begin backing slowly. 5. When your back wheels are level with the other car's bumper, turn the wheel toward the kerb. 6. Bring the car back at a shallow angle. 7. When the front clears the parked car, straighten the wheel. 8. Reverse gently until you are parallel with the kerb. 9. Adjust forward and back until you are centred in the space.
values.Callout: Slow and small. Let the wheel do the work.

deliverables.name: Driving-scenario training clip - Merging

values.Steps: 1. Build your speed along the slip road to match the traffic. 2. Check your mirrors as you go. 3. Look for a gap in the lane you are joining. 4. Signal to show where you are going. 5. Keep glancing between the road ahead and your mirror. 6. Ease into the gap at matching speed. 7. Do not stop on the slip road unless you have to. 8. Cancel your signal and keep a safe distance.
values.Callout: Match the speed, find the gap, ease in.
